demo.intro: Hello! Welcome to EkBill. Shall we take a short tour of the app?
demo.label: Demo · {n}/{total}
demo.s1: This is your Home. The pakka bill starts here: the real bill, with its number, counted in GST and your accounts.
demo.s2: And this is the Help button. Stuck anywhere? Tap it, and the app shows you what is where.
demo.s3: Just type three things: the work, how many, the rate. 'Ceiling fan, two, three hundred and fifty.' The total works itself out.
demo.s4: GST is added by itself too. No sums for you to do.
demo.s5: The bill is ready. Type the customer's number and their WhatsApp chat opens directly, even if the number is not saved.
demo.s6: Who still owes you shows here. One tap, and the reminder is ready on WhatsApp.
demo.s7: Have a handwritten bill? Take a photo, and EkBill reads it into a bill.
demo.s8: At the end of the month, your GST summary is ready too.
